components.template:
<app-mobile-form-sheet
  [open]="open"
  [title]="title"
  [hint]="hint"
  [showDefaultFooter]="false"
  (dismissed)="onDismissed()">
  <!--
    Footer buttons project into the sheet's fixed action bar. Declared after the
    stepper so stepStateChange from the child's reset/valuesChange is applied
    before these bindings are evaluated in the same CD pass.
  -->
  <cf-form-stepper
    *ngIf="open && stepperKey"
    [steps]="steps"
    [buildStepDefinition]="buildStepDefinition"
    [resolveSteps]="resolveSteps"
    [validateStep]="validateStep"
    [prepareStep]="prepareStep"
    [initialValues]="capturedInitialValues"
    [engineOptions]="engineOptions"
    [submitting]="saving"
    [completeLabel]="completeLabel"
    [idPrefix]="idPrefix"
    [showInlineActions]="false"
    (validationError)="validationError.emit($event)"
    (stepChange)="onStepChange($event)"
    (stepStateChange)="onStepState($event)"
    (completed)="completed.emit($event)"
    (cancelled)="onDismissed()">
    <ng-container *ngFor="let entry of customStepEntries; trackBy: trackCustomStep">
      <ng-template [cfFormStepperStep]="entry.stepId">
        <uld-list-form-custom-step-host
          [rendererKey]="entry.rendererKey"
          [data]="customStepDataFor(entry.stepId)"
          (dataChange)="onCustomStepData(entry.stepId, $event)"
          (ready)="onCustomStepHostReady($event)"
          (closed)="onCustomStepHostClosed($event)">
        </uld-list-form-custom-step-host>
      </ng-template>
    </ng-container>
    <ng-content></ng-content>
  </cf-form-stepper>

  <button
    sheetFooterActions
    *ngIf="open && stepperKey && (!isFirstStep || allowCancel)"
    type="button"
    class="app-btn app-btn--ghost"
    [disabled]="saving || preparing"
    (click)="onBack()">
    {{ isFirstStep ? cancelLabel : backLabel }}
  </button>
  <button
    sheetFooterActions
    *ngIf="open && stepperKey"
    type="button"
    class="app-btn app-btn--primary"
    [disabled]="saving || preparing"
    (click)="onNext()">
    {{ nextLabelText }}
  </button>
</app-mobile-form-sheet>
